text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock D, A, C, and E after gains, then soon bought several back; I should avoid treating gains as automatic sell signals and make each trade based on a clear portfolio rationale.","My account value moved sharply even when I made no trades, reinforcing that short-term price changes are unpredictable; I should not let daily monitoring drive impulsive decisions.","Frequent trading can reverse recent choices without improving results, so I should pause before trading, consider the full portfolio, and avoid reacting to loss aversion or the satisfaction of locking in gains."]}
